stories.title: Tennessee's Emma Clarke Hits for the Cycle in Fall Ball
stories.angle: One of the best pure hitters returning to college softball showcases her complete offensive game. Tennessee's 2027 lineup shapes up as one of the most dangerous in the nation.

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Emma Clarke hit for the cycle in Tennessee fall ball.

Single. Double. Triple. Home run. Six RBIs. Final: 32-0.

The 2027 Lady Vols lineup is going to be something. #GBO #Softball

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Emma Clarke had 14 HR in 2026 as a freshman.

Now she's hitting for the cycle in fall ball.

If you're not watching Tennessee softball in 2027, you're missing out. #GBO #Softball
